Hi Stephanie,

Thanks for the clear ask and the heads up on procurement timelines. We're excited to continue partnering with Olive. High-level response below; I can follow up with a formal one-pager and SLA addendum early next week.

High-level Premium SLA concept:
- Latency SLO: p95 < 80ms, p99 < 250ms (can tighten to p99 < 200ms with dedicated routing and warm KV caches)
- Support: 30-minute P1 response, 2-hour P1 acknowledgement with 24/7 on-call during your reporting windows, named TAM for renewal term
- Escalation: direct on-call line + weekly SLO review during the first 60 days

Burst/throughput plan:
- Option A: Dedicated pool sized to baseline with prepaid burst credits for 2x monthly spikes (metered consumption, predictable top-ups).
- Option B: Reserved higher-capacity pool during reporting windows (scheduled ramp) with lower per-token rate outside windows.

I'll attach a draft SLA matrix (SLA_matrix_v3.pdf) and a one-page pricing sketch. Can we schedule a 30-min call early next week to walk procurement through the addendum and onboarding timeline?

Sara / Procurement team —

Appreciate the prompt feedback. Next steps and commitments below so procurement and finance have what they need for the Tuesday review:

1) SLA addendum: I attached the SLA_addendum_OLV-2026-03.pdf (redline-friendly). Standalone DocuSign link will be sent when legal confirms final wording.
2) Latency commitment: Contractual target p99 < 200ms. Exception: up to 15 minutes per reporting window may experience elevated p99 due to KV cold starts; we'll include a mitigation clause that allows for proactive pre-warming at no additional charge if usage patterns are predictable.
3) Onboarding timeline (3 weeks):
   - Week 0: Agreement signed + kick-off — TAM intro, credentials & access, on-call schedule set.
   - Week 1: Dedicated pool provisioning, model variant pinning, KV caching policy configured, smoke tests.
   - Week 2: Traffic ramp & verification runs (we recommend a staged ramp to 50% then 100% of expected reporting load); SLO measurement and runbook validation.
   - Post-cutover (first 30 days): Weekly SLO review and optimization sessions.
4) Burst credits: We're modeling prepaid credits consumed at the same token rate as your baseline; we'll surface usage in your console and provide a monthly summary. Prepaid bucket suggested: 600k tokens/month with an overage rule and auto-top-up threshold you can control.
5) Commercials: Draft quote attached in the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deal/OLV-2026-03). Proposed term: 12 months starting at signing; baseline reserved + prepaid burst; 15% uplift to baseline pricing, 10% credit applied to prepaid bucket.

Action items:
- Stephanie: finalize SLA addendum and generate DocuSign link once legal clears (ETA Tue AM).
- Rishi: confirm the KV pre-warm procedure and sign-off on p99 commitment (ETA Tue EOD).
- Ben: attach prepaid-burst commercial template and finalize numbers for the quote (ETA Tue EOD).

If you want, we can lock a 30-min call Monday to walk procurement through the addendum before finance reviews.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.
